strategies.description: 50/50 legal Hit/Stand (21 stands), Raise/Pass and Call/Fold.
Hit below 15; otherwise Stand. Never Raise; always Call.
Hit below 17; otherwise Stand. Never Raise; always Call.
Production basic Hit below 17. Never Raise; Fold hard 12–14, Call other hands.
Production basic Hit below 17. Always Raise when first; always Call.
Hit hard totals below 16 and soft totals below 18. Raise on 19+. Fold hard 12–14; Call other hands.
Hit hard totals below 18 and soft totals below 19. Raise with probability .70 on 17+, .40 on hard 12–16, .55 otherwise. Call .70 on hard 12–14, .90 otherwise.

Untuned heuristic: Hit soft <19, hard <17, except Stand hard 16 versus visible 2–6 unless trailing by 3+. Raise 19+ always, 18 at .65, 17 at .35, otherwise .08 (.15 trailing by 3+, zero when ahead and one point from target). Call 15+, soft hands or <=11; hard 12–14 Call .65 against 7+ upcard, .80 otherwise. Always Call if folding would end the match.
